source_kind: Manufacturer calculation, not measured flight or wind-tunnel data
extraction: Numerical J/Ct/Cp columns checked against public source using web tool; not the complete source file.
method: Independent shape-preserving cubic (PCHIP) interpolation of Ct(J) and Cp(J); no fitting to aircraft trim
limitations: 30k-rpm coefficient shape reused at other RPM; RPM/Reynolds/Mach dependence not modeled
J<0 uses static coefficients; J above data is clamped and NOT validated
Negative thrust clipped to zero; stopped/windmilling/reverse-flow behavior not validated
No oblique inflow, blade flapping, motor power, battery, current or thermal model
